name: prompt-508
image_vibe: Moody dusk beach, cool low-saturation film, hazy melancholic atmosphere
image_purpose: Create an emotional coastal portrait with natural wind and soft cinematic film texture.

prompt.project_info: A soft emotional film-style close-up portrait on a beach at dusk.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman standing by the sea, with dark hair messy from the breeze and strands crossing her face. She wears a white opaque spaghetti-strap top and denim bottoms, with natural slightly flushed skin and realistic subtle texture.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up portrait, dark ocean waves behind her, moody sky, and soft sunset colors of dusty pink, blue-gray, and muted lavender.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural dusk light, hazy atmosphere, soft contrast, cool low-saturation cinematic treatment, melancholic but gentle mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Close-up portrait, realistic details, subtle film grain, cool-toned cinematic film filter, natural wind movement, no artificial sharpening.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a close-up soft emotional film-style portrait of an original adult woman standing on a beach at dusk. Her dark hair is messy from the sea breeze with strands blowing across her face; she wears a white opaque spaghetti-strap top and denim bottoms. Give her natural slightly flushed skin with subtle grainy texture. Show dark ocean waves and a moody sky with dusty pink, blue-gray, and muted lavender sunset colors. Use a low-saturation cool-toned cinematic film filter, soft contrast, slight grain, hazy atmosphere, natural lighting, and realistic details.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent top, exposed underwear, nudity, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: source dusk beach reference
assets.usage: Use only for beach composition, wind, sunset palette, and film treatment; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the dusk beach, white spaghetti-strap top, denim bottoms, windblown hair, cool film palette, and melancholic mood. Keep the subject original adult and the top opaque.

changes: Clarified an original adult subject and opaque top coverage.
Added safety and anti-artifact exclusions while preserving the beach-fashion concept.
